audit_status.source_base: Greek Gospel text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for Mark's opening, euangelion, Isaiah/Malachi wilderness messenger composite, John, baptism, Spirit descent, wilderness testing, basileia/metanoia proclamation, first disciples, Capernaum authority, unclean spirit language, Simon's mother-in-law, healing summary, prayer withdrawal, and skin-disease cleansing.

verses.restored: Beginning of the good message of Jesus Messiah, Son of the Divine.

familiar.text: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

verses.restored: As it has been written in Isaiah the prophet: Look, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way.

familiar.text: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

verses.restored: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord; make his paths straight.

familiar.text: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

verses.restored: John came baptizing in the wilderness and proclaiming a baptism of turning/realignment for release of sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

verses.restored: All the Judean region and all Jerusalem were going out to him, and they were baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

verses.restored: John was clothed with camel hair and a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

familiar.text: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

verses.restored: He proclaimed, saying, After me comes the one stronger than I; I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen the strap of his sandals.

familiar.text: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

verses.restored: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in holy Spirit.

familiar.text: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

verses.restored: In those days Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

familiar.text: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

verses.restored: Immediately, coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens being torn open and the Spirit descending into him like a dove.

familiar.text: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

verses.restored: A voice came from the heavens: You are my beloved Son; in you I delight.

familiar.text: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

verses.restored: Immediately the Spirit drives him out into the wilderness.

familiar.text: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

verses.restored: He was in the wilderness forty days, being tested by the adversarial one; he was with the wild animals, and the messengers served him.

familiar.text: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

verses.restored: After John was handed over, Jesus came into Galilee proclaiming the good message of the Divine,

familiar.text: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

verses.restored: and saying, The time has been fulfilled, and the reign of the Divine has drawn near; turn/realign and trust in the good message.

familiar.text: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

verses.restored: Passing along beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, Simon's brother, casting a net in the sea, for they were fishers.

familiar.text: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

verses.restored: Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you become fishers of people.

familiar.text: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

verses.restored: Immediately they left the nets and followed him.

familiar.text: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

verses.restored: Going on a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and John his brother, who also were in the boat mending the nets.

familiar.text: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

verses.restored: Immediately he called them, and leaving their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired workers, they went away after him.

familiar.text: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

verses.restored: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath he entered the synagogue and taught.

familiar.text: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

verses.restored: They were struck with wonder at his teaching, for he was teaching them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

familiar.text: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

verses.restored: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man in an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

familiar.text: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

verses.restored: What to us and to you, Jesus Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of the Divine.

familiar.text: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

verses.restored: Jesus rebuked it, saying, Be silent, and come out from him.

familiar.text: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

verses.restored: The unclean spirit convulsed him, cried with a loud voice, and came out from him.

familiar.text: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

verses.restored: They were all amazed, so that they discussed among themselves, saying, What is this? A new teaching with authority: he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.

familiar.text: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

verses.restored: Immediately the report about him went out everywhere into the whole surrounding region of Galilee.

familiar.text: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

verses.restored: Immediately, going out from the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

familiar.text: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

verses.restored: Simon's mother-in-law was lying down with fever, and immediately they spoke to him about her.

familiar.text: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

verses.restored: He came, raised her by taking her hand, and the fever left her; and she served them.

familiar.text: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

verses.restored: When evening came, when the sun set, they brought to him all who were sick and those troubled by unclean spirits.

familiar.text: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

verses.restored: The whole city was gathered at the door.

familiar.text: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

verses.restored: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many unclean spirits; he did not permit the spirits to speak, because they knew him.

familiar.text: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

verses.restored: Very early, while it was still dark, he rose, went out, and departed to a deserted place; there he prayed.

familiar.text: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

verses.restored: Simon and those with him searched for him.

familiar.text: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

verses.restored: They found him and said to him, Everyone is seeking you.

familiar.text: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

verses.restored: He said to them, Let us go elsewhere, into the neighboring towns, so that I may proclaim there also; for this is why I came out.

familiar.text: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

verses.restored: He went into all Galilee, proclaiming in their synagogues and casting out unclean spirits.

familiar.text: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

verses.restored: A man with a skin disease came to him, pleading and kneeling, saying, If you are willing, you are able to cleanse me.

familiar.text: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

verses.restored: Moved with compassion, Jesus stretched out his hand, touched him, and said, I am willing; be cleansed.

familiar.text: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

verses.restored: Immediately the skin disease left him, and he was cleansed.

familiar.text: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

verses.restored: Strictly warning him, he immediately sent him away,

familiar.text: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

verses.restored: and said to him, See that you say nothing to anyone, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing what Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.

familiar.text: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

verses.restored: But he went out and began to proclaim many things and spread the word, so that Jesus could no longer enter a city openly, but stayed outside in deserted places; and they came to him from everywhere.

familiar.text: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
